blocks.title: Quinoa bowls and hummus wraps
steps: Sunday: cook the quinoa and hard-boil 6 eggs; rinse the chickpeas.
Bowls (Mon, Wed, Fri): quinoa, spinach, chickpeas, cucumber, feta, olive oil and lemon.
Wraps (Tue, Thu): hummus, spinach, carrots and a sliced egg, rolled tight.
Keep dressing apart until lunch so the greens stay crisp.
